Jump as high as you can, raising your knees up, and then ensure a good land be re-extending your legs, absorbing impact through be allowing the knees to rebend.
اركع ورجل قدام والركبة الثانية على الأرض.
This drill helps increase arm efficiency during the run. Begin kneeling, left foot in front, right knee down. Apply pressure through the front heel to keep your glutes and hamstrings activated.
حرّك ذراعيك مثل الجري: ابدأ بطيء ثم هرولة ثم سرعة.

Begin by blocking the arms in long, pendulum like swings. Close the arm angle, blocking with the arms as you would when jogging, progressing to a run and finally a sprint. As soon as your hands pass the hip, accelerate them forward during the sprinting motion to move them as quickly as possible.
لما تعدي يدك الورك سرّعها للأمام، ثم بدّل الركبة.
Switch knees and repeat.

n: كرنش كيبل راكع مع لف جانبي
Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists
st: اربط حبل بالكيبل العالي واركع قدامه، والحبل خلف رأسك.

Connect a rope attachment to a high pulley cable and position a mat on the floor in front of it. Grab the rope with both hands and kneel approximately two feet back from the tower. Position the rope behind your head with your hands by your ears.
انزل بكرنش لين يوصل مرفقك لركبتك، ثم ارجع ببطء.

Keep your hands in the same place, contract your abs and pull downward on the rope in a crunching movement until your elbows reach your knees. Pause briefly at the bottom and rise up in a slow and controlled manner until you reach the starting position. Repeat the same downward movement until you're halfway down, at which time you'll begin rotating one of your elbows to the opposite knee.
في العدة التالية لف مرفق للركبة المقابلة، وبدّل الجهة كل مرة.

Again, pause briefly at the bottom and rise up in a slow and controlled manner until you reach the starting position. Repeat the same movement as before, but alternate the other elbow to the opposite knee. Continue this series of movements to failure.
حط بنش بالعرض قدام الكيبل العالي، واركع وظهرك للجهاز وأعلى ذراعك ورأسك على البنش.
Place a bench sideways in front of a high pulley machine. Hold a straight bar attachment above your head with your hands about 6 inches apart with your palms facing down.
امسك البار والمرافق مثنية.

Face away from the machine and kneel. Place your head and the back of your upper arms on the bench. Your elbows should be bent with the forearms pointing towards the high pulley. This will be your starting position.
افرد ذراعيك بنصف دائرة لين تستقيم، واشد التراي ثانية ثم ارجع ببطء.

While keeping your upper arms close to your head at all times with the elbows in, press the bar out in a semicircular motion until the elbows are locked and your arms are parallel to the floor. Contract the triceps hard and keep this position for a second. Exhale as you perform this movement. Slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
اركع والكفوف على الأرض والأصابع متجهة لركبك.
Start by kneeling on a mat with your palms flat and your fingers pointing back toward your knees.
ارجع بجسمك للخلف ببطء والكفوف ثابتة.
Slowly lean back keeping your palms flat on the floor until you feel a stretch in your wrists and forearms. Hold for 20-30 seconds.
لين تحس بإطالة الرسغ والساعد، واثبت ٢٠–٣٠ ثانية.
اربط حبل بالكيبل العالي واركع بعيد شوي والذراعين ممدودة.

Select the appropriate weight using a pulley that is above your head. Attach a rope to the cable and kneel a couple of feet away, holding the rope out in front of you with both arms extended. This will be your starting position.
اسحب الحبل لأعلى صدرك والمرافق للخارج وأنت تضم لوحي الكتف.
Initiate the movement by flexing the elbows and fully retracting your shoulders, pulling the rope toward your upper chest with your elbows out.
توقف لحظة ثم ارجع ببطء.
After pausing briefly, slowly return to the starting position.
اركع ورجلك اليمين قدام والقدم على الأرض، واليسار ممدودة للخلف.
Kneel on a mat and bring your right knee up so the bottom of your foot is on the floor and extend your left leg out behind you so the top of your foot is on the floor.
انقل وزنك للأمام لين تحس بإطالة في مقدمة الورك.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch in your hip. Hold for 15 seconds, then repeat for your other side.
اثبت ١٥ ثانية ثم بدّل.
اركع على الأرض والبار على ظهرك أو بوزن جسمك.

Begin kneeling on the floor with a barbell racked across the back of your shoulders, or you can use your body weight for this exercise. This can be done inside of a power rack to make unracking easier.
اجلس على كعبك ثم اندفع بالورك لين تنزل قدميك على الأرض.
Sit back with your hips until your glutes touch your feet, keeping your head and chest up. Explode up with your hips, generating enough power to land with your feet flat on the floor.
كمل بالسكوات وقم واقف.
Continue with the squat by driving through your heels and extending the knees to come to a standing position.

n: تجديف كيبل عالي بيد وحدة راكع
st: اركع قدام الكيبل العالي وامسك المقبض بيد والذراع ممدودة والكف للأمام.
Attach a single handle to a high pulley and make your weight selection.
اسحب لجسمك بثني المرفق وضم لوح الكتف، ولف الكف لجهتك.

Kneel in front of the cable tower, taking the cable with one hand with your arm extended. This will be your starting position. Starting with your palm facing forward, pull the weight down to your torso by flexing the elbow and retract the shoulder blade. As you do so, rotate the wrist so that at the completion of the movement, your palm is now facing you.
توقف لحظة ثم ارجع.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
اركع خلف البار في الرف وحطه على أعلى ظهرك، ويفضل تحط فرشة تحت ركبك.

Set the bar to the proper height in a power rack. Kneel behind the bar; it may be beneficial to put a mat down to pad your knees. Slide under the bar, racking it across the back of your shoulders. Your shoulder blades should be retracted and the bar tight across your back. Unrack the weight.
انزل بالمؤخرة لين تلمس كعبك والنظر للأمام.
With your head looking forward, sit back with your butt until you touch your calves.
ارجع بالجذع مستقيم.
Reverse the motion, returning the torso to an upright position.
ثبّت طرف البار في لاندماين، وارفع الطرف الثاني قدامك بيديك لمستوى الكتف.

Position a bar into a landmine or securely anchor it in a corner. Load the bar to an appropriate weight. Raise the bar from the floor, taking it to shoulder height with both hands with your arms extended in front of you. Adopt a wide stance. This will be your starting position.
لف الجذع والورك وأرجح البار لجهة لتحت، والذراعين ممدودة.
Perform the movement by rotating the trunk and hips as you swing the weight all the way down to one side. Keep your arms extended throughout the exercise.
ارجعه للجهة الثانية، وكمل بالتبادل.
Reverse the motion to swing the weight all the way to the opposite side. Continue alternating the movement until the set is complete.
ثبّت طرف البار في لاندماين، وارفع المقابض لأكتافك.

Position a bar into landmine or, lacking one, securely anchor it in a corner. Load the bar to an appropriate weight and position the handle attachment on the bar. Raise the bar from the floor, taking the handles to your shoulders. This will be your starting position.
انزل سكوات بوضعية رياضية.
In an athletic stance, squat by flexing your hips and setting your hips back, keeping your arms flexed.
اندفع بقوة بمد الورك والركب والكاحل وافرد ذراعيك، ثم ارجع.

Reverse the motion by powerfully extending through the hips, knees, and ankles, while also extending the elbows to straighten the arms. This movement should be done explosively, coming out of the squat to full extension as powerfully as possible. Return to the starting position.
انزل نصف سكوات ووجهك متعامد مع اتجاه الحركة.

Assume a half squat position facing 90 degrees from your direction of travel. This will be your starting position. Allow your lead leg to do a countermovement inward as you shift your weight to the outside leg.
انقل وزنك للرجل الخارجية واندفع لأبعد مسافة للجنب.
Immediately push off and extend, attempting to bound to the side as far as possible.
انزل واندفع مباشرة للجهة المقابلة، وكمل ذهاب وإياب.
Upon landing, immediately push off in the opposite direction, returning to your original start position. Continue back and forth for several repetitions.
قف وصندوق قصير جنبك.

Assume a comfortable standing position, with a short box positioned next to you. This will be your starting position. Quickly dip into a quarter squat to initiate the stretch reflex, and immediately reverse direction to jump up and to the side.
انزل ربع سكوات واقفز للأعلى وللجنب على الصندوق، وارفع ركبك.
Bring your knees high enough to ensure your feet have good clearance over the box.
انزل في نص الصندوق ثم انزل للجهة الثانية، وكمل ذهاب وإياب.
Land on the center of the box, using your legs to absorb the impact. Carefully jump down to the other side of the box, and continue going back and forth for several repetitions.
رتّب أقماع في صف، وقف جنب أولها.
Position a number of cones in a row several feet apart.
انزل شوي واقفز للجنب فوق القمع.

Stand next to the end of the cones, facing 90 degrees to the direction of travel. This will be your starting position. Begin the jump by dipping with the knees to initiate a stretch reflex, and immediately reverse direction to push off the ground, jumping up and sideways over the cone.
امتص الهبوط واقفز مباشرة فوق اللي بعده.
Use your legs to absorb impact upon landing, and rebound into the next jump, continuing down the row of cones.
قف على المطاط وامسك المقابض جنب فخذيك.

To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles using a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The handles should be resting on the sides of your thighs. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight. This will be your starting position.
ارفع ذراعيك للجنب لين تعدي مستوى الكتف شوي، والمرافق منثنية شوي.

Use your side shoulders to lift the handles to the sides as you exhale. Continue to lift the handles until they are slightly above parallel. Tip: As you lift the handles, slightly tilt the hand as if you were pouring water and keep your arms extended. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
توقف ثانية ثم نزّلها ببطء.
Lower the handles back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
استلقِ على جنبك والفوم رولر تحت إبطك من الخلف.
While lying on the floor, place a foam roll under your back and to one side, just behind your arm pit. This will be your starting position.
مد ذراع الجهة اللي تشتغل عليها، وحط وزنك على الرولر.
Keep the arm of the side being stretched behind and to the side of you as you shift your weight onto your lats, keeping your upper body off of the ground. Hold for 10-30 seconds, and switch sides.
اثبت ١٠–٣٠ ثانية ثم بدّل.

n: ضغط أرضي مع رجل فوق الثانية
st: استلقِ والكيتل بيل على صدرك، ورجل جهة العمل فوق الرجل الثانية.

Lie on the floor with one kettlebell in place on your chest, holding it by the handle. Extend leg on working side over leg on non-working side.Your free arm can be extended out to your side for support.
اضغط الكيتل بيل لين تقفل الذراع.
Press the kettlebll into a locked out position.
نزّلها لين يلمس المرفق الأرض، وكرر.
Lower the weight until the elbow touches the ground, keeping the kettlebell above the elbow. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
استلقِ على ظهرك واثنِ ركبة والقدم على الأرض.
Lie flat on your back, bend one knee, and put that foot flat on the floor to stabilize your spine.
ارفع الرجل الثانية للأعلى وافرد الركبة قدر ما تقدر.

Extend the other leg in the air. If you're tight, you wont be able to straighten it. That's okay. Extend the knee so that the sole of the lifted foot faces the ceiling (or as close as you can get it).
اسحبها ناحية وجهك بهدوء، ثم بدّل.
Slowly straighten the legs as much as possible and then pull the leg toward your nose. Switch sides.
قف وامسك شي ثابت للتوازن.

While standing up straight with both feet next to each other at around shoulder width, grab a sturdy surface such as the sides of a squat rack or the top of a chair to brace yourself and keep balance.
اثنِ رجل للخلف مثل ثني الفخذ الخلفي والرجل الثانية مستقيمة.

With or without an ankle weight, lift one leg behind you as if performing a leg curl but standing up while keeping the other leg straight. Breathe out as you perform this movement. Slowly bring the raised leg back to the floor as you breathe in.
نزّلها ببطء وكرر بالرجل الثانية.
Repeat the movement with the opposite leg.
اضبط المقعد لين تصير المقابض عند منتصف صدرك، والصدر مرفوع ولوحي الكتف مضمومة.
Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the bottom or middle of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion.
ادفع المقابض للأمام لين تستقيم الذراعين.
Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position. Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
ارجع ببطء بدون ما ترجّع الوزن للآخر إلا بعد المجموعة.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.
قف بين المقابض وامسك المقابض السفلية.

Load the pins to an appropriate weight. Position yourself directly between the handles. Grasp the bottom handles with a comfortable grip, and then lower your hips as you take a breath. Look forward with your head and keep your chest up. This will be your starting position.
انزل بالورك وخذ نفس، والصدر مرفوع والنظر للأمام.
Return the weight to the starting position.
قم بدفع كعبك لين تقف، ثم ارجع الوزن ببطء.
اضبط المقعد لين تصير المقابض عند أسفل صدرك، والصدر مرفوع.

Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the bottom of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion. Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
ادفع المقابض للأمام لين تستقيم الذراعين.
Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
ارجع ببطء والعضلة مشدودة.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.
اضبط المقعد لين توصل للمقابض فوقك، وثبّت ركبك تحت المسند.

Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that you can just reach the handles above you. Adjust the knee pad to help keep you down. Grasp the handles with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
اسحب المقابض لجسمك وأنت تضم لوحي الكتف.
Pull the handles towards your torso, retracting your shoulder blades as you flex the elbow. Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return the handles to the starting position.
توقف لحظة ثم ارجع ببطء.
For multiple repetitions, avoid completely returning the weight to the stops to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
اضبط المقعد لين تصير المقابض عند أعلى صدرك، والصدر مرفوع.

Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the top of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion. Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
ادفع المقابض لين تستقيم الذراعين.
Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
ارجع ببطء والعضلة مشدودة.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.
اضبط المقعد لين تصير المقابض عند أعلى أكتافك.

Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the top of the shoulders at the beginning of the motion. Your chest and head should be up and handles held with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
ادفع المقابض للأعلى لين تستقيم الذراعين.
Press the handles upward by extending through the elbow.
توقف لحظة ثم ارجع ببطء والعضلة مشدودة.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight to just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.
قف بين المقابض وامسك المقابض العلوية، وقم بدفع كعبك لين تقف والذراعين مستقيمة.

Load the pins to an appropriate weight. Position yourself directly between the handles. Grasp the top handles with a comfortable grip, and then lower your hips as you take a breath. Look forward with your head and keep your chest up.
ارفع أكتافك لأذنك بشكل مستقيم.

Drive through the floor with your heels, extending your hips and knees as you rise to a standing position. Keep your arms straight throughout the movement, finishing with your shoulders back. This will be your starting position.
توقف لحظة فوق ثم نزّل ببطء.
Raise the weight by shrugging the shoulders towards your ears, moving straight up and down. Pause at the top of the motion, and then return the weight to the starting position.
قف على خط، ورجلك اليسار قدام واليمين خلفها بـ١٠–١٥ سم.

This drill helps you accelerate as quickly as possible into a sprint from a dead stop. It helps to use a line to start from. Begin with two feet on the line. Place your left foot with the toe next to your right ankle. Place your right foot 4-6 inches behind the left.
حط يدك اليمين على الخط وانزل لين يقرب أنفك من ركبتك اليسار، ووزنك على الرجل الأمامية.

Place your right hand onto the line, and thing bring your nose close to your left knee. Squat down as you lean foward, your head being lower than your hips and your weight loaded onto the left leg. This will be your starting position.
ارفع يدك اليسار للخلف موازية للأرض، وانطلق بقوة لما تكون جاهز.
Take your left hand up so that it is parallel to the ground, pointing behind you, and explode out when ready.
مِل على الجدار بزاوية ٤٥ درجة والقدمين مع بعض والأرداف مشدودة.
Lean at around 45 degrees against a wall. Your feet should be together, glutes contracted.
ارفع ركبة بسرعة، توقف، ثم اضربها على الأرض للأسفل.
Begin by lifting your right knee quickly, pausing, and then driving it straight down into the ground. Switch legs, raising the opposite knee, and then attacking the ground straight down.
بدّل الرجل، وبعدها بدّل بين الرجلين بأسرع ما تقدر.
Repeat once more with your right leg, and as soon as the right foot strikes the ground hammer them out rapidly, alternating left and right as fast as you can.
جهّز صندوقين بينهم مسافة، وقف على واحد مقابل الثاني.
You will need two boxes or benches spaced a few feet away from each other. Begin by standing on one box facing towards the other platform.
انزل من الصندوق للأرض بهدوء والركب والورك منثنية.

To initiate the movement, gently drop down to the ground between your platforms, allowing the knees and hips to flex. Reverse the motion by exploding, extending through the hips, knees, and ankles to jump onto the other platform.
اندفع مباشرة واقفز على الصندوق الثاني، وانزل بنعومة.
Land softly, asborbing the impact through the legs.
قف والجذع قدامك وامسك المقابض، واسحبه لصدرك بمد الورك والركب.

Begin standing with the log in front of you. Grasp the handles, and begin to clean the log. As you are bent over to start the clean, attempt to get the log as high as possible, pulling it into your chest. Extend through the hips and knees to bring it up to complete the clean.
ارجع رأسك للخلف وسنده على صدرك، ثم انزل شوي بالركب واندفع.

Push your head back and look up, creating a shelf on your chest to rest the log. Begin the press by dipping, flexing slightly through the knees and reversing the motion. This push press will generate momentum to start the log moving vertically. Continue by extending through the elbows to press the log above your head. There are no strict rules on form, so use whatever techniques you are most efficient with. As the log is pressed, ensure that you push your head through on each repetition, looking forward.
افرد ذراعيك واضغطه فوق رأسك، ونزّله بتحكم.
Repeat as many times as possible. Attempt to control the descent of the log as it is returned to the ground.
اربط حبل تسلق بعارضة عالية، وقف على بار سميث مقفول أو صندوق ثابت تحته.

Attach a climbing rope to a high beam or cross member. Below it, ensure that the smith machine bar is locked in place with the safeties and cannot move. Alternatively, a secure box could also be utilized.
والجسم مستقيم، ارجع للخلف وانزل بتبديل اليدين على الحبل لين يصير جسمك عمودي على الأرض تقريباً.

Stand on the bar, using the rope to balance yourself. This will be your starting position. Keeping your body straight, lean back and lower your body by slowly going hand over hand with the rope. Continue until you are perpendicular to the ground.
اطلع بنفس الطريقة لين ترجع للبداية.
Keeping your body straight, reverse the motion, going hand over hand back to the starting position.
اركع وامسك كعبيك بيديك.
Kneel on the floor, holding your heels with both hands.
ادفع الورك للأمام وارجع رأسك للخلف وانظر للسقف.
Lift your buttocks up and forward while bringing your head back to look up at the ceiling, to give an arch in your back.
اثبت على تقوس خفيف في الظهر.
استلقِ على مقعد جهاز التجديف ورأسك جهة الحبل، وامسك الحبل والكفوف متقابلة.

Select the desired weight and lay down face up on the bench of a seated row machine that has a rope attached to it. Your head should be pointing towards the attachment. Grab the outside of the rope ends with your palms facing each other (neutral grip).
أعلى الذراع عمودي للسقف والمرفق بزاوية ٩٠.

Position your elbows so that they are bent at a 90 degree angle and your upper arms are perpendicular (90 degree angle) to your torso. Tip: Keep the elbows in and make sure that the upper arms point to the ceiling while your forearms point towards the pulley above your head. This will be your starting position.
افرد ساعدك للأعلى وشد التراي ثانية، ثم ارجع ببطء.

As you breathe out, extend your lower arms until they are straight and vertical. The upper arms and elbows remain stationary throughout the movement. Only the forearms should move. Contract the triceps hard for a second. As you breathe in slowly return to the starting position.
اجلس على جهاز التجديف وامسك الحبل بقبضة فوقية، والظهر مستقيم.
Sit on a low pulley row machine with a rope attachment.
ارفع المرافق واسحب الحبل لرقبتك، وأعلى الذراع موازي للأرض.

Grab the ends of the rope using a palms-down grip and sit with your back straight and your knees slightly bent. Tip: Keep your back almost completely vertical and your arms fully extended in front of you. This will be your starting position. While keeping your torso stationary, lift your elbows and start bending them as you pull the rope towards your neck while exhaling. Throughout the movement your upper arms should remain parallel to the floor. Tip: Continue this motion until your hands are almost next to your ears (the forearms will not be parallel to the floor at the end of the movement as they will be angled a bit upwards) and your elbows are out away from your sides.
اثبت ثانية ثم ارجع ببطء والجذع ثابت.
After holding for a second or so at the contracted position, come back slowly to the starting position as you inhale. Tip: Again, during no part of the movement should the torso move.
اجلس والفوم رولر تحت أسفل ظهرك، وكتّف ذراعيك قدامك.
In a seated position, place a foam roll under your lower back. Cross your arms in front of you and protract your shoulders. This will be your starting position.
ارفع وركك ومِل للخلف، وحط الوزن على العضلات جنب العمود الفقري مو عليه.

Raise your hips off of the floor and lean back, keeping your weight on your lower back. Now shift your weight slightly to one side, keeping your weight off of the spine and on the muscles to the side of it. Roll over your lower back, holding points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on the other side.
دحرج واثبت على النقاط المشدودة ١٠–٣٠ ثانية، ثم الجهة الثانية.
انبطح على بطنك وذراعيك للجنب.
Lie on your stomach with your arms out to your sides. This will be your starting position.
ارفع صدرك عن الأرض بعضلات أسفل الظهر بدون ما تدفع بيديك.
Using your lower back muscles, extend your spine lifting your chest off of the ground. Do not use your arms to push yourself up. Keep your head up during the movement. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
كرر ١٠–٢٠ مرة والرأس مرفوع.
قف والكيتل بيل في يدك اليمين.
Stand with your torso upright holding a kettlebell in your right hand. This will be your starting position.
خطوة للأمام بالرجل اليسار وانزل لين تقرب الركبة الخلفية من الأرض.

Step forward with your left foot and lower your upper body down by flexing the hip and the knee, keeping the torso upright. Lower your back knee until it nearly touches the ground. As you lunge, pass the kettlebell under your front leg to your opposite hand.
مرّر الكيتل بيل تحت رجلك الأمامية لليد الثانية، ثم اطلع.
Pressing through the heel of your foot, return to the starting position.
خذ بار السميث على أعلى ظهرك وافتح رجليك أمام وخلف.

Adjust a bar in a Smith machine to an appropriate height. Position yourself under the bar, racking it across the back of your shoulders. Unrack the bar, and then split your feet, moving one foot forward and one foot back. This will be your starting position.
انزل لين تقرب الركبة الخلفية من الأرض.
Lower your back knee nearly to the ground, flexing the knees and lowering your hips as you do so.
اندفع بقوة واقفز وبدّل وضعية رجليك في الهواء.

At the bottom of the descent, immediately reverse direction. Explosively drive through the heel of your front foot with light pressure from your back foot. Jump up and reverse the position of your legs.

n: إطالة الفخذ الداخلي مستلقي مع شريك
st: استلقِ والركب مثنية وباطن القدمين ملاصق، والشريك ماسك ركبك.
Lie on your back with your knees bent and the soles of the feet pressed together. Have your partner hold your knees. This will be your starting position.
حاول تضم ركبك ١٠–٢٠ ثانية والشريك يمنعك.
Attempt to squeeze your knees together, while your partner prevents any movement from occurring.
ارخِ وخل الشريك ينزّل ركبك للأرض بهدوء، وقل له يوقف لما تكفي الإطالة.
After 10-20 seconds, relax your muscles as your partner gently pushes your knees towards the floor. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching.
استلقِ على فرشة قدام الكيبل السفلي وقدميك على الجهاز، وامسك البار بقبضة سفلية.

Grab a straight bar or E-Z bar attachment that is attached to the low pulley with both hands, using an underhand (palms facing up) shoulder-width grip. Lie flat on your back on top of an exercise mat in front of the weight stack with your feet flat against the frame of the pulley machine and your legs straight.
المرافق قريبة من جسمك، ارفع البار لصدرك وأنت تشد الباي.
With your arms extended and your elbows close to your body slightly bend your arms. This will be your starting position.
اشد ثانية ثم نزّله ببطء.

While keeping your upper arms stationary and the elbows close to your body, curl the bar up slowly toward your chest as you breathe out and you squeeze the biceps. After a second squeeze at the top of the movement, slowly return to the starting position.
حط البار المنحني تحت بنش وانبطح عليه، وامسكه بقبضة فوقية عريضة.
Place a cambered bar underneath an exercise bench.
اسحب البار لصدرك لأعلى الظهر، أو لبطنك للظهر العريض، والمرافق قريبة.

Lie face down on the exercise bench and grab the bar using a palms down (pronated grip) that is wider than shoulder width. This will be your starting position. As you exhale row the bar up as you keep the elbows close to your body to either your chest, in order to target the upper mid back, or to your stomach if targeting the lats is your goal.
اثبت ثانية ثم نزّله ببطء.
After a second hold at the top, lower back down to the starting position slowly as you inhale.

n: Lying Close-Grip Bar Curl On High Pulley
st: حط بنش قدام الكيبل العالي، وامسك البار بقبضة سفلية واستلقِ ورأسك عند طرف البنش.
Place a flat bench in front of a high pulley or lat pulldown machine. Hold the straight bar attachment using an underhand grip (palms up) that is about shoulder width.
افرد ذراعيك فوق أكتافك عمودية.

Lie on your back with your head over the end of the bench. Now extend your arms straight above your shoulders. Your torso and your arms should make a 90-degree angle and the elbows should be in. This will be your starting position.
اسحب البار بنصف دائرة لين يلمس ذقنك وأعلى الذراع ثابت، ثم ارجع ببطء.

As you breathe out, curl the bar down in a semicircular motion until it touches your chin. Squeeze the biceps for a second at the top contracted position. Tip: As you execute this motion only the forearms should move. At no time should the upper arms be moving at all. They are to remain perpendicular throughout the movement. Return to starting position slowly.

n: Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Extension Behind The Head
st: استلقِ ورأسك عند طرف البنش، وارفع البار فوق رأسك والذراعين موازية للأرض.

While holding a barbell or EZ Curl bar with a pronated grip (palms facing forward), lie on your back on a flat bench with your head close to the end of the bench. Tip: If you are holding a barbell grab it using a shoulder-width grip and if you are using an E-Z Bar grab it on the inner handles.
انزل البار بثني المرفقين لين يصير الساعد عمودي على الأرض.

Extend your arms in front of you and slowly bring the bar back in a semi circular motion (while keeping the arms extended) to a position over your head. At the end of this step your arms should be overhead and parallel to the floor. This will be your starting position. Tip: Keep your elbows in at all times. As you inhale, lower the bar by bending at the elbows and while keeping the upper arm stationary. Keep lowering the bar until your forearms are perpendicular to the floor.
ارجعه بنصف دائرة وشد التراي، وأعلى الذراع ثابت.

As you exhale bring the bar back up to the starting position by pushing the bar up in a semi-circular motion until the lower arms are also parallel to the floor. Contract the triceps hard at the top of the movement for a second. Tip: Again, only the forearms should move. The upper arms should remain stationary at all times.

n: Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Press To Chin
st: استلقِ على بنش والبار فوق صدرك بقبضة ضيقة.

While holding a barbell or EZ Curl bar with a pronated grip (palms facing forward), lie on your back on a flat bench with your head off the end of the bench. Tip: If you are holding a barbell grab it using a shoulder-width grip and if you are using an E-Z Bar grab it on the inner handles.
نزّله بنصف دائرة لين يلمس ذقنك، وأعلى الذراع ثابت والمرافق للداخل.

Extend your arms in front of you as you hold the barbell over your chest. The arms should be perpendicular to your torso (90-degree angle). This will be your starting position. As you inhale, lower the bar in a semi-circular motion by bending at the elbows and while keeping the upper arm stationary and elbows in. Keep lowering the bar until it lightly touches your chin.
افرده للأعلى وشد التراي ثانية.

As you exhale bring the bar back up to the starting position by pushing the bar up in a semi-circular motion. Contract the triceps hard at the top of the movement for a second. Tip: Again, only the forearms should move. The upper arms should remain stationary at all times.
استلقِ على ظهرك، وحط رجل مثنية عبر جسمك، والشريك ماسك كتفك وركبتك.
Lie on your back with your legs extended.
حاول ترفع الركبة والشريك يمنعك ١٠–٢٠ ثانية.

Cross one leg over your body with the knee bent, attempting to touch the knee to the ground. Your partner should kneel beside you, holding your shoulder down with one hand and controlling the crossed leg with the other. this will be your starting position. Attempt to raise the bent knee off of the ground as your partner prevents any actual movement.
ارخِ وخل الشريك ينزّل الركبة بهدوء للأرض، ثم بدّل.
After 10-20 seconds, relax the leg as your partner gently presses the knee towards the floor. Repeat with the other side.
استلقِ على بنش والدمبلز فوقك والكفوف متقابلة والمرافق للداخل.

Lie on a flat bench while holding two dumbbells directly in front of you. Your arms should be fully extended at a 90-degree angle from your torso and the floor. The palms should be facing in and the elbows should be tucked in. This is the starting position.
نزّل الدمبلز لين تقرب من أذنيك وأعلى الذراع ثابت.
As you breathe in and you keep the upper arms stationary with the elbows in, slowly lower the weight until the dumbbells are near your ears.
افرد ذراعيك بالتراي وأنت تخرج النفس.
At that point, while keeping the elbows in and the upper arms stationary, use the triceps to bring the weight back up to the starting position as you breathe out.

n: Lying Face Down Plate Neck Resistance
st: انبطح على بنش وأكتافك عند طرفه، وامسك قرص خفيف خلف رأسك.

Lie face down with your whole body straight on a flat bench while holding a weight plate behind your head. Tip: You will need to position yourself so that your shoulders are slightly above the end of a flat bench in order for the upper chest, neck and face to be off the bench. This will be your starting position.
نزّل رأسك ببطء مثل حركة «نعم».
While keeping the plate secure on the back of your head slowly lower your head (as in saying "yes") as you breathe in.
ارفعه للبداية واثبت ثانية. استخدم وزن خفيف جداً.
Raise your head back up to the starting position in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out. Hold the contraction for a second.

n: Lying Face Up Plate Neck Resistance
st: استلقِ على بنش وأكتافك عند طرفه، وامسك قرص خفيف على جبهتك.

Lie face up with your whole body straight on a flat bench while holding a weight plate on top of your forehead. Tip: You will need to position yourself so that your shoulders are slightly above the end of a flat bench in order for the traps, neck and head to be off the bench. This will be your starting position.
نزّل رأسك للخلف ببطء.
While keeping the plate secure on your forehead slowly lower your head back in a semi-circular motion as you breathe in.
ارفعه للبداية واثبت ثانية. استخدم وزن خفيف جداً.
Raise your head back up to the starting position in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out. Hold the contraction for a second.
استلقِ وارفع رجل وحطها بحيث القدم فوق الورك المقابل، والشريك ماسك الركبة والكاحل.
Lie on your back with your partner kneeling beside you.
حاول تدفع رجلك للشريك وهو يمنعك ١٠–٢٠ ثانية.

Flex the hip of one leg, raising it off of the floor. Rotate the leg so the foot is over the opposite hip, the lower leg perpendicular to your body. Your partner should hold the knee and ankle in place. This will be your starting position. Attempt to push your leg towards your partner, who should be preventing any actual movement of the leg.
ارخِ وخل الشريك يدفع رجلك لصدرك بهدوء لين تكفي الإطالة.

After 10-20 seconds, completely relax as your partner gently pushes the ankle and knee towards your chest. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching.

n: إطالة الفخذ الخلفي مستلقي مع شريك
st: استلقِ وارفع رجل للأعلى والشريك ماسك كاحلك.

Lie on your back with your legs extended. Your partner should be kneeling beside you. Raise one leg up towards the ceiling and have your partner hold the ankle. Your partner can use their shoulder to brace your leg if necessary. This will be your starting position.
حاول تثني الركبة وتشد الفخذ الخلفي ١٠–٢٠ ثانية والشريك يمنعك.
With your partner holding your leg in place, attempt to flex the knee, contracting the hamstrings for 10-20 seconds.
ارخِ وخل الشريك يدفع رجلك لرأسك بهدوء، ثم بدّل.

Then relax your leg, allowing your partner to gently push the leg towards your head. Be sure to inform your helper when the stretch is adequate to prevent injury or overstretching. Switch sides once complete.

n: بايسبس بالبار منبطح على بنش عالي
st: انبطح على بنش عالي وأعلى صدرك عند طرفه، والبار في يديك مدلّى للأسفل.

Lie face forward on a tall flat bench while holding a barbell with a supinated grip (palms facing up). Tip: If you are holding a barbell grab it using a shoulder-width grip and if you are using an E-Z Bar grab it on the inner handles. Your upper body should be positioned in a way that the upper chest is over the end of the bench and the barbell is hanging in front of you with the arms extended and perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position.
ارفع البار بنصف دائرة وأعلى الذراع ثابت وأنت تشد الباي.
While keeping the elbows in and the upper arms stationary, curl the weight up in a semi-circular motion as you contract the biceps and exhale. Hold at the top of the movement for a second.
اثبت ثانية ثم نزّله ببطء بدون تأرجح.
As you inhale, slowly go back to the starting position. Tip: Maintain full control of the weight at all times and avoid any swinging. Remember, only the forearms should move throughout the movement.
ادخل الجهاز على ظهرك وأكتافك تحت المساند والقدمين بعرض الكتفين.

Adjust the leg machine to a height that will allow you to get inside it with your knees bent and the thighs slightly below parallel. Once you select the weight, position yourself inside the machine face up with the knees bent and thighs slightly below parallel to the platform. Make sure that the knees do not go past the toes. The angle created between the hamstrings and the calves should be one that is slightly less than 90 degrees (since your starting position requires you to start slightly below parallel). Your back and your head should be resting on the machine while your shoulders are pressed under the shoulder pads.
ادفع بقدميك لين تستقيم رجليك وشد الفخذ الأمامي.
Place your hands by the handles and position your feet slightly pointing out at a shoulder width position. This will be your starting position.
انزل ببطء لين يصير فخذك موازي للمنصة، ثم ادفع مرة ثانية.

While pressing with the balls of the feet as you breathe out, make your whole body erect as you squeeze the quads. Hold the contracted position for a second. Tip: Since you are starting below parallel, you can opt to use your hands to help you up by pressing on your thighs only on the first repetition. Slowly squat down as you inhale but instead of going all the way down to the starting position, just stop once your thighs are parallel to the platform. The angle between your hamstrings and calves should be a 90-degree angle.
انبطح على بنش مستوي ودمبل في يد، واليد الثانية ماسكة البنش.
While holding a dumbbell in one hand, lay with your chest down on a flat bench. The other hand can be used to hold to the leg of the bench for stability.
ارفع الذراع للجنب لمستوى الكتف والمرفق منثني شوي.

Position the palm of the hand that is holding the dumbbell in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arm extended with the elbow slightly bent. This will be your starting position. Now raise the arm with the dumbbell to the side until your elbow is at shoulder height and your arm is roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arm perpendicular to the torso while keeping your arm extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second.
اثبت ثانية ثم نزّلها ببطء، وبدّل.
Slowly lower the dumbbell to the starting position as you inhale.

n: إطالة الفخذ الأمامي منبطح مع شريك
st: انبطح واثنِ ركبة لين تقرب القدم من المؤخرة، والشريك ماسك الركبة والكاحل.

Lay face down on the floor with your partner kneeling beside you. Flex one knee and raise that leg off the ground, attempting to touch your glutes with your foot. Your partner should hold the knee and ankle. This will be your starting position.
حاول تفرد الركبة والشريك يمنعك ١٠–٢٠ ثانية.

Attempt to extend your knee while your partner prevents any actual movement. After 10-20 seconds, relax your muscles as your partner gently pushes the foot towards your glutes, further stretching the quadriceps and hip flexors.
ارخِ وخل الشريك يدفع القدم للمؤخرة بهدوء، ثم بدّل.
After 10-20 seconds, switch sides.
انبطح على بنش مستوي ودمبل في كل يد والكفوف لجسمك.
While holding a dumbbell in each hand, lay with your chest down on a flat bench.
ارفع ذراعيك للجنب لمستوى الكتف والمرافق منثنية شوي.

Position the palms of the hands in a neutral manner (palms facing your torso) as you keep the arms extended with the elbows slightly bent. This will be your starting position. Now raise the arms to the side until your elbows are at shoulder height and your arms are roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale. Tip: Maintain your arms perpendicular to the torso while keeping them extended throughout the movement. Also, keep the contraction at the top for a second.
اثبت ثانية ثم نزّلها ببطء.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the starting position as you inhale.
استلقِ على بنش ونزّل ذراعيك للأسفل على جنب البنش قدر ما تقدر والكفوف لجسمك.

Lie down on a flat bench face up while holding a dumbbell in each arm on top of your thighs. Bring the dumbbells to the sides with the arms extended and the palms of the hands facing your thighs (neutral grip).
ارفع الدمبلز وأنت تلف الكف للأعلى لين تنقبض الباي، وأعلى الذراع ثابت.

While keeping the arms close to your torso and elbows in, slowly lower your arms (as you keep them extended with a slight bend at the elbows) as far down towards the floor as you can go. Once you cannot go down any further, lock your upper arms in that position and that will be your starting position.
ارجع ببطء شديد.

As you breathe out, slowly begin to curl the weights up as you simultaneously rotate your wrists so that the palms of the hands face up. Continue curling the weight until your biceps are fully contracted and squeeze hard at the top position for a second. Tip: Only the forearms should move. Upper arms should remain stationary and elbows should stay in throughout the movement. Return back to the starting position very slowly.
اضبط جهاز التي بار بحيث أعلى صدرك عند طرف المسند، وانبطح وامسك المقابض.

Load up the T-bar Row Machine with the desired weight and adjust the leg height so that your upper chest is at the top of the pad. Tip: In some machines all you can do is stand on the appropriate step that allows you to be at a height that has the upper chest at the top of the pad. Lay face down on the pad and grab the handles. You can either use a palms down, palms up, or palms in position depending on what part of your back you want to emphasize.
ارفع البار واسحبه لجسمك وأنت تضغط الظهر، والمرافق قريبة.
Lift the bar off the rack and extend your arms in front of you. This will be your starting position.
اثبت ثانية ثم نزّله ببطء بدون ما ترفع جسمك.

As you exhale slowly pull the weight up and squeeze your back at the top of the movement. Tip: Keep the upper arms as close to the torso as possible throughout the movement in order to better engage the back muscles. Also, do not lift your body off of the pad at any time and refrain from using the biceps to lift the weight. After a second contraction at the top of the movement, as you inhale, slowly go back down to the starting position.
استلقِ على بنش وامسك البار بقبضة متوسطة فوقك والذراعين عمودية.
Lie on a flat bench with either an e-z bar (my preference) or a straight bar placed on the floor behind your head and your feet on the floor.
نزّل البار لين يلمس جبهتك لمسة خفيفة وأعلى الذراع ثابت.

Grab the bar behind you, using a medium overhand (pronated) grip, and raise the bar in front of you at arms length. Tip: The arms should be perpendicular to the torso and the floor. The elbows should be tucked in. This is the starting position. As you breathe in, slowly lower the weight until the bar lightly touches your forehead while keeping the upper arms and elbows stationary.
افرده للأعلى بالتراي وأنت تخرج النفس.
At that point, use the triceps to bring the weight back up to the starting position as you breathe out.
اضبط المقعد وحط أعلى ذراعيك على المسند وامسك المقابض.
Adjust the seat to the appropriate height and make your weight selection. Place your upper arms against the pads and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.
اثنِ مرفقيك واسحب المقابض لجهتك.
Perform the movement by flexing the elbow, pulling your lower arm towards your upper arm. Pause at the top of the movement, and then slowly return the weight to the starting position.
توقف لحظة ثم ارجع ببطء والعضلة مشدودة.
Avoid returning the weight all the way to the stops until the set is complete to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
اجلس وأعلى ذراعيك على المسند والمرافق للداخل، وامسك المقابض بقبضة سفلية.
Sit down on the Preacher Curl Machine and select the weight.
ارفع المقابض وأنت تشد الباي، واثبت ثانية فوق.

Place the back of your upper arms (your triceps) on the preacher pad provided and grab the handles using an underhand grip (palms facing up). Tip: Make sure that when you place the arms on the pad you keep the elbows in. This will be your starting position. Now lift the handles as you exhale and you contract the biceps. At the top of the position make sure that you hold the contraction for a second. Tip: Only the forearms should move. The upper arms should remain stationary and on the pad at all times.
نزّلها ببطء.
Lower the handles slowly back to the starting position as you inhale.
اضبط المقعد وحط أعلى ذراعيك على المسند وامسك المقابض.
Adjust the seat to the appropriate height and make your weight selection. Place your upper arms against the pads and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.
افرد مرفقيك وادفع المقابض.
Perform the movement by extending the elbow, pulling your lower arm away from your upper arm. Pause at the completion of the movement, and then slowly return the weight to the starting position.
توقف لحظة ثم ارجع ببطء والعضلة مشدودة.
Avoid returning the weight all the way to the stops until the set is complete to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
قف مقابل شريك أو جدار والكرة عند صدرك.
You will need a partner for this exercise. Lacking one, this movement can be performed against a wall. Begin facing your partner holding the medicine ball at your torso with both hands.
ادفع الكرة بفرد مرفقيك، وممكن تاخذ خطوة وأنت ترمي.
Pull the ball to your chest, and reverse the motion by extending through the elbows. For sports applications, you can take a step as you throw.
استقبل الكرة لما ترجع بيديك عند الصدر.
Your partner should catch the ball, and throw it back to you. Receive the throw with both hands at chest height.

n: لف كامل بالكرة الطبية مع شريك
st: قف وظهرك لظهر الشريك بينكم ٦٠–٩٠ سم، والكرة قدام جذعك.
For this exercise you will need a medicine ball and a partner. Stand back to back with your partner, spaced 2-3 feet apart. This will be your starting position.
لف أكتافك ووركك مع الشريك بنفس الاتجاه وسلّمه الكرة.

Hold the ball in front of the trunk. Open the hips and turn the shoulders at the same time as your partner. For full rotation, you and your partner should twist in the same direction, i.e. counter-clockwise.
لفوا للاتجاه الثاني وكرروا.
Pass the ball to your partner, and both of you can now twist in the opposite direction to repeat the procedure.
انزل نص سكوات والكرة بين قدميك بذراعين ممدودة.
Assume a semisquat stance with a medicine ball in your hands. Your arms should hang so the ball is near your feet.
ادفع الورك للأمام واقفز للأعلى.
Begin by thrusting the hips forward as you extend through the legs, jumping up.
أرجح ذراعيك فوق رأسك وافلت الكرة في أعلى نقطة لترميها لأبعد مسافة خلفك.
As you do, swing your arms up and over your head, keeping them extended, releasing the ball at the peak of your movement. The goal is to throw the ball the greatest distance behind you.
انبطح على بنش مائل ودمبل في كل يد مدلّاة والكفوف متقابلة.

Lie facedown on an incline bench while holding a dumbbell in each hand. Your arms should be fully extended hanging down and pointing towards the floor. The palms of your hands should be facing each other. This will be your starting position.
ضم لوحي الكتف لبعض وأنت تخرج النفس، واثبت ثانية كاملة.

As you exhale, squeeze your shoulder blades together and hold the contraction for a full second. Tip: This movement is just like the reverse action of a hug, or trying to perform rear laterals as if you had no arms.
ارجع ببطء. الذراعين مستقيمة والحركة من لوح الكتف فقط.
As you inhale go back to the starting position.
قف والقدمين بعرض الكتفين ويديك على خصرك.
Stand so your feet are shoulder width apart and your hands are on your hips.
لف خصرك لجهة لين تحس بالإطالة.
Twist at your waist until you feel a stretch. Hold for 10 to 15 seconds, then twist to the other side.
اثبت ١٠–١٥ ثانية ثم لف للجهة الثانية.
امسك بار العقلة أعرض من الكتفين شوي، يد الكف للأمام والثانية لجهتك.

Using a spacing that is just about 1 inch wider than shoulder width, grab a pull-up bar with the palms of one hand facing forward and the palms of the other hand facing towards you. This will be your starting position.
اسحب نفسك للأعلى وأنت تخرج النفس.

Now start to pull yourself up as you exhale. Tip: With the arm that has the palms facing up concentrate on using the back muscles in order to perform the movement. The elbow of that arm should remain close to the torso. With the other arm that has the palms facing forward, the elbows will be away but in line with the torso. You will concentrate on using the lats to pull your body up. After a second contraction at the top, start to slowly come down as you inhale.
اثبت ثانية ثم انزل ببطء، وبدّل وضع اليدين في المجموعة التالية.

On the following set, switch grips; so if you had the right hand with the palms facing you and the left one with the palms facing forward, on the next set you will have the palms facing forward for the right hand and facing you for the left.
وأنت تجري، اثنِ الركبة وكأنك تركل المؤخرة لما يمتد الورك.
This move helps prepare your running form to help you excel at sprinting. As you run, be sure to flex the knee, aiming to kick your glutes as the hip extends.
رجّع الرجل للأمام واضرب الأرض في الخطوة التالية.
Reload the quad as the leg moves back forward, attacking the ground on the next step.
حرّك ذراعيك بسرعة مع الإيقاع.
Ensure that as you run, you block with the arms, punching through in a rapid 1-2 motion.
امسك البار بقبضة عريضة عند منتصف الفخذ، والصدر مرفوع.

Begin with a loaded barbell held at the mid thigh position with a wide grip. The feet should be directly below the hips, with the feet turned out as needed. Lower the hips, with the chest up and the head looking forward. The shoulders should be just in front of the bar. This will be the starting position.
اسحب بدفع الكعبين ثم امدد الورك والركب والكاحل بسرعة، والبار قريب من جسمك.

Begin the pull by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar. Transition into the second pull by extending through the hips knees and ankles, driving the bar up as quickly as possible. The bar should be close to the body.
كمل رفع البار فوق رأسك بدون ما تثني ركبك مرة ثانية.
Continue raising the bar to the overhead position, without rebending the knees.
امسك الحلقات بقبضة كاذبة، واسحب نفسك مثل العقلة.
Grip the rings using a false grip, with the base of your palms on top of the rings. Initiate a pull up by pulling the elbows down to your side, flexing the elbows.
لما توصل فوق اسحب الحلقات لإبطك وقدّم أكتافك.

As you reach the top position of the pull-up, pull the rings to your armpits as you roll your shoulders forward, allowing your elbows to move straight back behind you. This puts you into the proper position to continue into the dip portion of the movement. Maintaining control and stability, extend through the elbow to complete the motion.
افرد مرفقيك لتكمل فوق الحلقات، وانزل بحذر. تمرين متقدم.
Use care when lowering yourself to the ground.
ظهرك على مسند الجهاز وأكتافك تحت المساند، والقدمين متقاربة.

Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided. Position your legs in the platform using a less than shoulder width narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Your feet should be around 3 inches or less apart. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
فك الأمان وافرد رجليك بدون قفل الركبة.

Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position). Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position.
انزل ببطء لين تصير الركبة أقل من ٩٠ درجة، ثم اطلع بدفع كعبك.

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heels of your feet as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
اجلس على جهاز الدفع وقدميك على المنصة متقاربة.

Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a less-than-shoulder-width narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Your feet should be around 3 inches or less apart. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
فك الأمان وادفع لين تستقيم رجليك بدون قفل الركبة.

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position. As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
نزّل المنصة لين تصير الركبة ٩٠ درجة، ثم ادفع بكعبك.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
في الرف، حط البار على أعلى ظهرك، والقدمين متقاربة ٨–١٥ سم.

This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it. Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.
انزل ببطء والظهر مستقيم لين تنزل تحت الموازاة شوي.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a less-than-shoulder-width narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Feet should be around 3-6 inches apart. Keep your head up at all times (looking down will get you off balance) and maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).
اطلع بدفع كعبك وأنت تخرج النفس.

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
حط رولر صغير خلف رقبتك على العضلات جنب العمود الفقري، مو على العمود نفسه.

Using a muscle roller or a rolling pin, place the roller behind your head and against your neck. Make sure that you do not place the roller directly against the spine, but turned slightly so that the roller is pressed against the muscles to either side of the spine. This will be your starting position.
دحرج من أعلى الرقبة للأسفل ببطء.
Starting at the top of your neck, slowly roll down the muscles of your neck, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds.
اثبت على النقاط المشدودة ١٠–٣٠ ثانية.
استلقِ على البنش وامسك البار بقبضة متوسطة فوق رقبتك.

Lie back on a flat bench. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over your neck with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
نزّله ببطء لين يقرب من رقبتك.

As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your neck. After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up).
ادفعه للأعلى بالصدر. تمرين خطر؛ وزن خفيف ومساعد دائماً.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
استلقِ على جنبك اليمين والرجلين فوق بعض والركب منثنية شوي.
Start out by lying on your right side with your legs lying on top of each other. Make sure your knees are bent a little bit. Place your left hand behind your head.
حط يدك اليسار خلف رأسك.
Once you are in this set position, begin by moving your left elbow up as you would perform a normal crunch except this time the main emphasis is on your obliques.
ارفع المرفق للأعلى وأنت تشد عضلات الخصر وتخرج النفس، اثبت ثانية ثم انزل.

Crunch as high as you can, hold the contraction for a second and then slowly drop back down into the starting position. Remember to breathe in during the eccentric (lowering) part of the exercise and to breathe out during the concentric (elevation) part of the exercise.
البار على أعلى الكتفين والصدر مرفوع والقدمين بعرض الورك.
Begin with a barbell supported on top of the traps. The chest should be up, and the head facing forward. Adopt a hip width stance with the feet turned out as needed.
انزل بثني الركب للأمام بدون ما ترجع بالورك كثير، والجذع مستقيم لين تنزل لآخر مدى.

Descend by flexing the knees, refraining from moving the hips back as much as possible. This requires that the knees travel forward; ensure that they stay aligned with the feet. The goal is to keep the torso as upright as possible. Continue all the way down, keeping the weight on the front of the heel.
اندفع للأعلى بدفع مقدمة الكعب.
At the moment the upper legs contact the lower, reverse the motion, driving the weight upward.
استلقِ على بنش وخل رجل وذراع مدلّاة من الجنب.
Lie on a flat bench or step, and hang one leg and arm over the side.
اثنِ الركبة وامسك مقدمة القدم بدون ما تقوّس ظهرك.
Bend the knee and hold the top of the foot. As you do this, be careful not to arch your lower back.
اضغط قدمك في يدك واثبت، ثم بدّل.
Pull the belly button to the spine to stay in neutral. Press your foot down and into your hand. To add the hip stretch, lift the hip of the leg you're holding up toward the ceiling.
استلقِ على جنبك اليمين والركبة اليمين مثنية قدامك.
Start off by lying on your right side, with your right knee bent at a 90-degree angle resting on the floor in front of you (this stabilizes the torso).
اثنِ ركبتك اليسار للخلف وامسك قدمك بيدك.
Bend your left knee behind you and hold your left foot with your left hand. To stretch your hip flexor, press your left hip forward as you push your left foot back into your hand. Switch sides.
ادفع الورك للأمام والقدم في يدك، ثم بدّل.

n: تفتيح دمبل بيد وحدة على بنش
st: استلقِ على بنش مستوي والدمبل فوقك بيد، واليد الثانية ماسكة البنش.

Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand resting on top of your thigh. The palm of your hand with the dumbbell in it should be at a neutral grip. By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbell up, clean the dumbbell so that you can hold it in front of you with your lifting arm being fully extended. Remember to maintain a neutral grip with this exercise. Your non lifting hand should be to the side holding the flat bench for better support. This will be your starting position.
نزّل الذراع للجنب بقوس واسع والمرفق منثني شوي لين تحس بإطالة الصدر.

Your arm with the weight should have a slight bend on your elbow in order to prevent stress at the biceps tendon. Begin by lowering your arm with the weight in it out in a wide arc until you feel a stretch on your chest. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout the movement, your lifting arm should remain stationary; the movement should only occur at the shoulder joint.
ارجعها بنفس القوس وأنت تشد الصدر، ثم بدّل.

Return your lifting arm back to the starting position as you squeeze your chest muscles and breathe out. Tip: Make sure to use the same arc of motion used to lower the weights. Hold for a second at the contracted position and repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

n: ميلان جانبي بالكيبل العالي بيد وحدة
st: قف وجنبك للكيبل العالي، واسحب المقبض لين يلمس المرفق جنبك.

Connect a standard handle to a tower. Move cable to highest pulley position. Stand with side to cable. With one hand, reach up and grab handle with underhand grip. Pull down cable until elbow touches your side and the handle is by your shoulder.
ثبّت الذراع ومِل للجنب بشد عضلات الخصر.
Position feet hip-width apart. Place free hand on hip to help gauge pivot point. Keep arm in static position. Contract oblique to bring the weight down in a side crunch.
ارجع ببطء والوزن مشدود، وكرر ثم بدّل.

Once you reach maximum contraction, slowly release the weight to the starting position. The weight stack should never be unloaded in a resting position. The aim is constant tension during the set. Repeat to failure. Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite side.

n: رفرفة جانبية بيد وحدة على بنش مائل
st: استلقِ على جنبك على بنش مائل والدمبل في اليد العليا قدامك.

Lie down sideways on an incline bench press with a dumbbell in the hand. Make sure the shoulder is pressing against the incline bench and the arm is lying across your body with the palm around your navel.
ارفع الذراع للأعلى لين تصير متجهة للسقف وأنت تخرج النفس.

Hold a dumbbell in your uppermost arm while keeping it extended in front of you parallel to the floor. This is your starting position. While keeping the dumbbell parallel to the floor at all times, perform a lateral raise. Your arm should travel straight up until it is pointing at the ceiling. Tip: Exhale as you perform this movement. Hold the dumbbell in the position and feel the contraction in the shoulders for a second.
اثبت ثانية ثم نزّلها عبر جسمك ببطء، وبدّل.
While inhaling lower the weight across your body back into the starting position.
حط الكيتل بيل بين قدميك، وارجع بالورك والنظر للأمام وامسكها.
Place a kettlebell between your feet. As you bend down to grab the kettlebell, push your butt back and keep your eyes looking forward.
اسحبها لكتفك بدفعة من الرجلين والورك ولف رسغك.
Clean the kettlebell to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The wrist should rotate as you do so.
نزّلها للبداية وكرر.
Return the weight to the starting position.
اسحب الكيتل بيل لكتفك والكف للأمام.

Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward.
انزل شوي بالركب ثم اندفع واضغطها فوق رأسك، وانزل تحتها بسكوات بسيط.

Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright. Immediately reverse direction, driving through the heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press the kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight.
قم واقف والكيتل بيل فوق، ثم نزّلها للأرض للعدة التالية.

Receive the weight overhead by returning to a squat position underneath the weight. Keeping the weight overhead, return to a standing position. Lower the weight to the floor to perform the next repetition.
استلقِ على الأرض والكيتل بيل في يد، وأعلى الذراع على الأرض والكف لجسمك.
Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell with one hand, with your upper arm supported by the floor. The palm should be facing in.
اضغطها للسقف وأنت تلف الرسغ.
Press the kettlebell straight up toward the ceiling, rotating your wrist.
نزّلها للبداية وكرر.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position and repeat.
اسحب الكيتل بيل لكتفك والكف للأمام.

Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position.
انزل شوي بالركب والجذع مستقيم، ثم اندفع واضغطها فوق رأسك.

Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright. Immediately reverse direction, driving through the heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press the kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight. Receive the weight overhead by returning to a squat position underneath the weight. Keeping the weight overhead, return to a standing position.
استقبلها بسكوات بسيط ثم قم، ونزّلها للعدة التالية.
Lower the weight to perform the next repetition.

n: ضغط كيتل بيل للجنب بيد وحدة
One-Arm Kettlebell Military Press To The Side
st: اسحب الكيتل بيل لكتفك والكف للداخل.

Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces inward. This will be your starting position.
انظر للكيتل بيل واضغطها للأعلى وللخارج لين تقفل الذراع.
Look at the kettlebell and press it up and out until it is locked out overhead.
نزّلها للكتف بتحكم، وشد البطن والأرداف للثبات.
Lower the kettlebell back to your shoulder under control and repeat. Make sure to contract your lat, butt, and stomach forcefully for added stability and strength.
اسحب الكيتل بيل لكتفك والكف للأمام والمرفق للجنب.

Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position.
اضغطها للأعلى وللخارج لين تقفل الذراع.
Hold the kettlebell with the elbow out to the side, and press it up and out until it is locked out overhead.
نزّلها للكتف بتحكم وشد البطن والأرداف.
Lower the kettlebell back to your shoulder under control and repeat. Make sure to contract your lat, butt, and stomach forcefully for added stability and strength.
اسحب الكيتل بيل لكتفك والكف للأمام.

Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position.
انزل شوي بالركب ثم اندفع واستخدم الدفعة لتضغطها فوق رأسك.
Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.
نزّلها للكتف وكرر.

Immediately reverse direction, driving through the heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press the kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight. Lower the weight to perform the next repetition.
حط الكيتل بيل قدام قدميك، اثنِ ركبك شوي وارجع بالورك وانحنِ.

Place a kettlebell in front of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and then push your butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the starting position. Grab the kettlebell and pull it to your stomach, retracting your shoulder blade and flexing the elbow. Keep your back straight. Lower and repeat.
امسكها واسحبها لبطنك وأنت تضم لوح الكتف، والظهر مستقيم.
نزّلها ببطء وكرر.
حط الكيتل بيل بين قدميك، اثنِ ركبك وارجع بالورك.
Place a kettlebell between your feet. Bend your knees and push your butt back to get in the proper starting position.
أرجحها للخلف بين رجليك ثم اندفع بالورك للأمام.
Look straight ahead and swing the kettlebell back between your legs.
لما تطلع لف يدك واضرب للأعلى واستقبلها فوق رأسك والذراع مقفولة.

Immediately reverse the direction and drive through with your hips and knees, accelerating the kettlebell upward. As the kettlebell rises to your shoulder rotate your hand and punch straight up, using momentum to receive the weight locked out overhead.
اسحب الكيتل بيل لكتفك والكف للأمام.

Hold a kettlebell by the handle. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward. This will be your starting position. Dip your body by bending the knees, keeping your torso upright.
انزل شوي ثم اندفع واضغطها فوق رأسك، واستقبلها ورجل قدام ورجل خلف.

Immediately reverse direction, driving through the heels, in essence jumping to create momentum. As you do so, press the kettlebell overhead to lockout by extending the arms, using your body's momentum to move the weight.
ضم رجليك وأنت ماسكها فوق، ثم نزّلها.

Receive the weight overhead by returning to a squat position underneath the weight, positioning one leg in front of you and one leg behind you. Keeping the weight overhead, return to a standing position and bring your feet together. Lower the weight to perform the next repetition.
امسك الكيتل بيل بيد وانزل للأرض.
Hold a kettlebell in one hand by the handle.
امدد الورك والركب والكاحل وارفعها فوق رأسك.

Squat towards the floor, and then reverse the motion, extending the hips, knees, and finally the ankles, to raise the kettlebell overhead. After fully extending the body, descend into a lunge position to receive the weights overhead, one leg forward and one leg back. Ensure you drive through with your hips and lock the ketttlebells overhead in one uninterrupted motion.
استقبلها بوضعية لانج رجل قدام ورجل خلف، ثم ضم رجليك ونزّلها.
Return to a standing position, holding the weight overhead, and bring the feet together. Lower the weight to return to the starting position.
قف والكيتل بيل قدامك، ارجع بالورك وامسكها بيد وحدة والظهر مستقيم.
Stand with the kettlebell in front of you, hinge at the hips and grab it with one hand, back flat.
أرجحها للخلف بين رجليك، ثم ادفع الورك للأمام بقوة لين ترتفع لمستوى الصدر.
Swing it back between your legs, then drive your hips forward hard until it rises to chest height.
خلها ترجع بين رجليك وكرر، والقوة من الورك مو من الذراع.
Let it swing back between your legs and repeat; the power comes from the hips, not the arm.
ثبّت طرف البار في لاندماين أو زاوية، وقف جنبه وامسك قرب الأقراص بيد.

Position a bar into a landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving. Load an appropriate weight onto your end. Stand next to the bar, and take a grip with one hand close to the collar. Using your hips and legs, rise to a standing position.
انحنِ والورك للخلف والصدر مرفوع والذراع ممدودة.
Assume a bent-knee stance with your hips back and your chest up. Your arm should be extended. This will be your starting position.
اسحب الوزن لجنبك بضم الكتف وثني المرفق، ثم نزّله ببطء بدون هز.
Pull the weight to your side by retracting the shoulder and flexing the elbow. Do not jerk the weight or cheat during the movement. After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
قف بوضعية رياضية والكرة في اليد اللي بجهة الرجل الخلفية.
Start in a standing position with a staggered, athletic stance. Hold a medicine ball in one hand, on the same side as your back leg. This will be your starting position.
ارفع الكرة فوق رأسك وامدد جسمك.

Begin by winding the arm, raising the medicine ball above your head. As you do so, extend through the hips, knees, and ankles to load up for the slam. At peak extension, flex the shoulders, spine, and hips to throw the ball hard into the ground directly in front of you.
اضربها بقوة في الأرض قدامك، واستقبلها لما ترتد وكرر.
Catch the ball on the bounce and continue for the desired number of repetitions.

n: كلين الكف المفتوح بكيتل بيل وحدة
st: حط الكيتل بيل بين قدميك وامسك المقبض بيد.
Place one kettlebell between your feet.
ارفعها بسرعة وخلها تنقلب لين تنزل كرتها في كفك.

Grab the handle with one hand and raise the kettlebell rapidly, let it flip so that the ball of the kettlebell lands in the palm of your hand. Throw the kettlebell out in front of you and catch the handle with one hand.
ارمها قدامك شوي وامسك المقبض، ثم نزّلها وكرر لكل يد.
Take the kettlebell to the floor and repeat. Make sure to work both arms.

n: سكوات بكيتل بيل فوق الرأس بيد وحدة
st: اسحب الكيتل بيل واضغطها فوق رأسك والذراع مقفولة.

Clean and press a kettlebell with one arm. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards your shoulder. Rotate your wrist as you do so. Press the weight overhead by extending through the elbow.This will be your starting position.
انزل سكوات والرأس والصدر مرفوعين والكيتل بيل ثابتة فوق.
Looking straight ahead and keeping a kettlebell locked out above you, flex the knees and hips and lower your torso between your legs, keeping your head and chest up.
توقف ثانية تحت ثم اطلع بدفع كعبك.
Pause at the bottom position for a second before rising back to the top, driving through the heels of your feet.
قف جنب منتصف البار، وانزل بثني الركب وامسكه مثل الشنطة.
Stand to the side of a barbell next to its center. Bend your knees and lower your body until you are able to reach the barbell.
اطلع بدفع رجليك وأنت تخرج النفس لين تقف.

Grasp the bar as if you were grabbing a briefcase (palms facing you since the bar is sideways). You may need a wrist wrap if you are using a significant amount of weight. This is your starting position. Use your legs to help lift the barbell up while exhaling. Your arms should extend fully as bring the barbell up until you are in a standing position.
نزّله ببطء بثني الركب، وبدّل اليد.
Slowly bring the barbell back down while inhaling. Tip: Make sure to bend your knees while lowering the weight to avoid any injury from occurring.

n: رفرفة جانبية بيد وحدة مع سند
st: امسك الدمبل بيد والثانية ماسكة شي ثابت، ومِل شوي لجهة الدمبل.

Pick a dumbbell and place it in one of your hands. Your non lifting hand should be used to grab something steady such as an incline bench press. Lean towards your lifting arm and away from the hand that is gripping the incline bench as this will allow you to keep your balance.
ارفع الدمبل للجنب والمرفق منثني شوي لين يوازي الأرض، بدون تأرجح.

Stand with a straight torso and have the dumbbell by your side at arm's length with the palm of the hand facing you. This will be your starting position. While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the dumbbell to your side with a slight bend on the elbow and your hand slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arm is parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top.
توقف ثانية ثم نزّلها ببطء، وبدّل.
Lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale.
قف وحط ذراعك مثنية على جدار أو باب.
From a standing position, place a bent arm against a wall or doorway.
مِل ببطء باتجاه ذراعك.
Slowly lean toward your arm until you feel a stretch in your lats.
لين تحس بإطالة في جانب الظهر، واثبت.
لف منشفة على بار العقلة، وامسك البار بيد والمنشفة باليد الثانية.

For this exercise, start out by placing a towel around a chin up bar. Grab the chin-up bar with your palm facing you. One hand will be grabbing the chin-up bar and the other will be grabbing the towel.
مِل للخلف ٣٠ درجة والصدر بارز، واسحب لين يلمس أعلى صدرك البار.
Bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.v
انزل ببطء وبدّل اليد. تمرين متقدم.

Pull your torso up until the bar touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar. After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
استلقِ على بنش والدمبل بيد فوق صدرك والكف للأمام.

Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand on top of your thigh. By using your thigh to help you get the dumbbell up, clean the dumbbell up so that you can hold it in front of you at shoulder width. Use the hand you are not lifting with to help position the dumbbell over you properly.
نزّلها ببطء لجنب صدرك وأنت تاخذ نفس.
Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrist forward so that the palm of your hand is facing away from you. This will be your starting position.
ادفعها للأعلى بعضلات الصدر وأنت تخرج النفس، وبدّل اليد.

Bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbell at all times. Tip: Use the hand that you are not lifting with to help keep the dumbbell balance as you may struggle a bit at first. Only use your non-lifting hand if it is needed. Otherwise, keep it resting to the side. As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
حط أعلى ذراعك على بنش الواعظ والدمبل في يدك.
Grab a dumbbell with the right arm and place the upper arm on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench. The dumbbell should be held at shoulder length. This will be your starting position.
نزّلها ببطء لين تمتد الذراع وتحس بإطالة الباي.

As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbell until your upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched. As you exhale, use the biceps to curl the weight up until your biceps is fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder height. Again, remember that to ensure full contraction you need to bring that small finger higher than the thumb.
ارفعها لكتفك وشد الباي ثانية، ثم بدّل.
Squeeze the biceps hard for a second at the contracted position and repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
استلقِ على الأرض والركب مثنية، وخل شريك يعطيك البار في يد بقبضة محايدة.

Lie down on a flat surface with your back pressing against the floor or an exercise mat. Make sure your knees are bent. Have a partner hand you the bar on one hand. When starting, your arm should be just about fully extended, similar to the starting position of a barbell bench press. However, this time your grip will be neutral (palms facing your torso).
نزّل البار لين يلمس المرفق الأرض وأنت تاخذ نفس.
Make sure the hand you are not using to lift the weight is placed by your side.
ادفعه للأعلى وأنت تخرج النفس، وبدّل اليد.

Begin the exercise by lowering the barbell until your elbow touches the ground. Make sure to breathe in as this is the eccentric (lowering part of the exercise). Then start lifting the barbell back up to the original starting position. Remember to breathe out during the concentric (lifting part of the exercise).
اضبط المسند على ركبك وامسك المقبض بقبضة فوقية.
Select an appropriate weight and adjust the knee pad to help keep you down. Grasp the handle with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
اسحب المقبض للأسفل والمرفق لجنبك.
Pull the handle down, squeezing your elbow to your side as you flex the elbow. Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return the handle to the starting position.
توقف لحظة ثم ارجع ببطء، وبدّل اليد.
